admissionRule: Every prespecified route has at least 16 substantive answers and an observed native solve rate strictly below 50%.

sample.question: How many times does wire B cross another wire?
How many CLOSED boundaries must a path from the red dot cross to reach the outer margin?
Which candidate is EXACTLY the same connected shape as the reference after rotation only (no reflection)?
Which panel is PERFECTLY mirror-symmetric across its red vertical axis? The other three each contain one mismatched dot.
Which structure contains exactly 28 unit cubes? Every column is solid down to the floor.
Which option is the EXACT cell-by-cell XOR of INPUT 1 and INPUT 2? Each wrong option differs from the true XOR in only ONE cell.
In which labeled quadrant of the RIGHT grid is the one rotated glyph?
In which panel is there an open route through the maze from S to G?
Which graph has an Eulerian CIRCUIT: one closed route that uses every edge exactly once? Line crossings without a dot are not vertices.
Which panel has an EVEN number of black dots in EVERY row AND EVERY column? Each other panel has exactly one odd row and one odd column.
How many times does the RED-RINGED target disk ENTER the gold zone? Count each outside→inside transition and ignore every other disk.
How many collision events involve the specific pair A AND B together? Ignore collisions involving any other pairing.
The gold token is shown at the start, then all tokens become identical. After the 12 shown swaps, which numbered slot contains the original gold token?
How many times does the RED-RINGED target disk flash yellow? Ignore every other disk.
How many times is a BLUE CIRCLE immediately followed by a RED SQUARE in the complete sequence? Count overlapping occurrences.
How many DIFFERENT grid cells lit up at least once? Repeats count only once.
How many times does the moving gold disk CHANGE DIRECTION during the complete route?
Which labeled box contains the MOST tokens after all twenty one-token transfers? Initial counts are shown only at the beginning.
How many times does the complete route CROSS ITSELF? Count only true crossings, not turns or revisited endpoints.
Starting from ZERO, where does the hidden counter end after every +1 and -1 event?
